title: What's My Car Worth?
description: Keith Martin and Josh Nasar attend a Barrett-Jackson auction event in Scottsdale, Ariz., where they drive a low-mileage Ferrari 512 TR and a survivor 1967 Corvette.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description: Josh takes a spin in a 2005 Ford GT, a sports car inspired by the 1960s GT40 that achieved success at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description: A rare Lamborghini Miura SV, one of only five single-sump SVs sold new to the United States, hits the auction block in Arizona.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description: Keith cruises in a restored Alfa Romeo Giulietta Spider Veloce; Josh drives a 1997 Porsche Turbo S, which was the last 911 Turbo manufactured with an air-cooled engine.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description: Vehicles at a Barrett-Jackson event in Scottsdale, Ariz., include a 1967 Shelby GT500 Fastback and a 1970 Plymouth 'Cuda with an original 440 Six-Pack.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description: Keith and Josh attend a Barrett-Jackson event in Scottsdale, Ariz., where they find a beautifully restored Chevrolet Chevelle SS LS5 and test out a Porsche 930 Turbo; Keith gets behind the wheel of a Ferrari 365 GTB/4 Daytona.

title: What's My Car Worth?
description: Keith Martin and Josh Nasar encounter plenty of muscle at a Barrett-Jackson collector car auction in Scottsdale, Ariz., including a Pontiac GTO Judge and a 1987 Buick GNX.

title: Engineering the Future
description: Engineers race to generate vast power from thin air: the wind; one of the world's biggest wind farms is being built in harsh conditions along the coast of England; a Norwegian team works on the world's first floating wind farm.

title: Engineering the Future
description: A new breed of aviators is innovating new ways to fly from clean and green electric aircraft to autonomous sky taxis.

title: Engineering the Future
description: Exploring the quest to produce fusion -- an ultimate energy solution that has been likened to "bottling a star.".

title: Engineering the Future
description: The power of the oceans' tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth; from sub-sea kites to floating platforms, teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flows of water.

title: Engineering the Future
description: Shipping companies and engineers create remarkable new machines to make their industry greener, using a resource that has moved man across the world's oceans for thousands of years: wind.

title: Engineering the Future
description: The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system; innovators search for new ways to capture more of the sun's power and make it available through the night, everywhere.

description: As the battle distance continues to grow with each new weapon, humans put their best minds to work refining and evolving their designs over the millennia to gain the upper hand.

description: Groundbreaking developments lead to a technologically sophisticated society; the first data-recording device from over 5,000 years ago; how weaving creates binary code; electric cars are invented 100 years earlier than originally imagined.
